name: svelte-effect-runtime-vscode
description: VS Code extension that installs and launches the SER LSP from the npm registry.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm run clean && vp node ../../build/ext.ts
scripts.package: corepack pnpm run build && vp node ../../build/vsix.ts

commands.title: Svelte Effect Runtime: Start Language Server
Svelte Effect Runtime: Stop Language Server
Svelte Effect Runtime: Restart Language Server

svelte-effect-runtime.languageServer.ena.description: Start the auto-installed Svelte Effect Runtime language server automatically for .svelte and .sv files.

svelte-effect-runtime.languageServer.cli.description: Language-client strategy. Auto uses the official Svelte extension client when installed to avoid duplicate Svelte language servers, otherwise it starts the bundled VS Code client directly.

svelte-effect-runtime.languageServer.pat.description: Absolute path to a custom svelte-effect-runtime-language-server script. Leave empty to install the server from the npm registry.
